productionBaselineEvidence: Publisher-side verified source a43e1813d62a151e8294a52989a80fe21b36057c was published to production Android channel/runtime 1.3.2 via run 43355306642, OTA 01a1d2d6-bae3-74df-bbf4-2bdd9df35215. Installed production/staging handset fingerprints, RC native build and app behavior remain NOT independently verified. Documentation-only changes here must never trigger a product deploy.
chosenApproach: Preserve existing Navigation V2 PR #783 21-item canonical completion gate, integrate Wall PR #784 only after physical evidence, reuse SALIKSIK PR #777's domain/privacy/rewards contracts, and classify all 30 owner screenshots in a machine-readable JSON matrix backed by a focused CI-integrity test.
selectionRationale: A separate governance plan avoids stale PR patch duplication and permits reliable multi-workstream reconciliation without mutating runtime code, rollout flags, secure backend schema, points or the release channel.
alternativeApproaches: Directly append speculative all-in-one runtime/UI/backend changes to the active Navigation V2 branch (rejected: conflicting scopes, inadequate native verification, incomplete 21-item acceptance).
Create a new navigation and SALIKSIK domain implementation (rejected: duplicates approved #783 and #777 systems and risks role/points regressions).
Publish staging or production merely because documentation and source CI pass (rejected: actual signed installed device and runtime evidence mandatory).
preserveBehaviors: Canonical Home|Cluster|Wall|Connect|Profile and scoped Home/Community/Connect stay in the existing Navigation PR #783 and its 21-item checklist.
Existing Active Wall/Marites video, IMA, AdMob, PTT, notifications, keyboard GIF fallback, auth and offline reading remain untouched.
Existing SALIKSIK private source vault, human-reviewed written Master, canonical pending ledger max +205 and feature rollout OFF remain untouched.
No UI runtime files, SQL migrations, new dependencies, app assets, backend instances, OTA or web production channels changed.
Actual shipped app/staging verification status remains separate from plan/CI success.
acceptanceChecks: 30 numbered, unique photo concepts are classified in the JSON crosswalk.
All 21 canonical Navigation 2.0 requirement IDs are present as NOT_VERIFIED references and are not replaced by a competing checklist.
All workstreams have unique IDs, satisfiable dependencies, clear owner/source and mandatory evidence gate.
Release status remains documentationOnly=true, no physical staging or production publish asserted; web/prod require explicit owner approval.
Source, tests, V2 manifest and human-reviewed documentation stay isolated to these four exact paths.
Existing PR #783, #784 and #777 remain separate until current-main source reconciliation and compiled staging-Android acceptance.
releaseStatus: Documentation-only DEV PR, no runtime, no staging APK/OTA, no web/production publication.
